name: COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
minutes_text:
COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
MINUTES
CITY OF BALDWIN PARK
COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 18, 2009
7:00 p.m. COUNCIL CHAMBERS
14403 E. Pacific Avenue
Baldwin Park
Manuel Lozano, Mayor
Marlen Garcia, Mayor Pro Tem Monica Garcia, Ricardo Pacheco, Susan Rubio, Council Members
Maria Contreras, City Treasurer Alejandra Avila, City Clerk
The COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION of the City of Baldwin Park met in REGULAR SESSION at the above time and place.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
Present: Member Bejarano, Member Marlen Garcia, Member Pacheco, Vice Chair Monica Garcia, Chair Lozano.
Absent: None.
Also Present: Chief Executive Officer Vijay Singhal, City Attorney Joseph W. Pannone, Director of Recreation & Community Services Manuel Carrillo Jr., Community Development Manager Marc Castagnola, Director of Public Works William Galvez, Chief of Police Lili Hadsell, Director of Finance Lorena Quijano, City Treasurer Contreras, City Clerk Rubio, Deputy City Clerk Nieto.
PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS
NONE
CONSENT CALENDAR
1. MINUTES
Staff Report
Commission approved the regular meeting minutes of November 4, 2009.
2. CONCEPTUAL REVIEW FOR A PARCEL MAP (PM-1408) FOR THREE (3) INDUSTRIAL CONDOMINIUM PROPERTIES AND ONE (1) COMMON AREA PROPERTY (SAN GABRIEL RIVER REDEVELOPMENT PROJECT AREA;) LOCATION: 4700-4750 LITTLEJOHN STREET; APPLICANT: BEVERLY JOHNSON; CASE NO. CDC 09-03
Staff Report
Commission waived further reading, read by title only and adopted Resolution No. 454 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK CONCEPTUALLY APPROVING THE PROPOSED INDUSTRIAL CONDOMINIUM SUBDIVISION FOR THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 4700-4750 LITTLEJOHN STREET WITHIN THE SAN GABRIEL RIVER REDEVELOPMENT PROJECT AREA; LOCATION: 4700 - 4750 LITTLEJOHN STREET; APPLICANT: BEVERLY JOHNSON; CASE NO.: CDC 09-03."
Motion: Approve CONSENT CALENDAR
Moved by Member Bejarano, seconded by Chair Lozano.
ADJOURNMENT
There being no other matters for discussion the meeting was adjourned at 9:46 p.m.
Approved as presented by the Commission at their meeting held December 2, 2009.
Laura M. Nieto, CMC
Deputy City Clerk
